brand.name: Mowgli Games
brand.tagline: Soft, round, and a little silly.

sentence.en: Mowgli Games is an independent studio making soft, playful casual games that anyone can pick up and enjoy.
sentence.ko: 모글리 게임즈는 누구나 쉽게 시작하고 즐길 수 있는, 말랑하고 장난스러운 캐주얼 게임을 만드는 인디 스튜디오입니다.

set.name: Pebbles
set.mechanism: A small balancing act: two flat stones and a yolk ball perched slightly off-centre on top, about to wobble.
set.expression_move: The off-centre yellow ball; stones and wordmark stay one colour.
set.differs_by: Quiet and calm where casual games are usually loud, with one silly detail.

logo.concept: Two flat stones with a yolk ball balanced off-centre on top.

defaults_used.why: The user asked for a deep yellow key colour on dark (questionnaire A11) and picked set B's yolk; the flagged tone is that same yellow, not a gold accent added for warmth.

rationale.claim: Type and palette are set B as picked by the user; only the logo is explored here.
Dark ground with a deep yellow key colour is the user's stated preference.
Off-centre balance reads as playful tension; asymmetry reads as exciting (context-bound).
